summary: FCSS 2 is a utility‑first CSS framework that compiles class names into a more readable CSS format. It ships as a CLI tool and a PostCSS plugin, running via npm without requiring an API key. It targets front‑end developers who want Tailwind‑like syntax but prefer generated CSS files, offering a modest convenience layer. The main strength is its zero‑runtime approach, while its major caveat is very low adoption and minimal differentiation from established frameworks.

github.description: Functional CSS: utility classes named after real CSS properties. One class, one declaration, zero runtime. Works with Vite, Next.js, Astro and Angular.
